data.name: ToolDrawShoreline

data.comment: The tool that puts finger piers, piles or booms between berths.

data.name: HintDrawLandAreaFirst
data.value: Click to place the first corner of the land area.

data.name: HintDrawLandAreaCorners
data.value: Click to add corners (at least 3). Backspace removes the last one, Esc cancels.

data.name: HintDrawLandAreaFinish
data.value: Click to add corners; double-click, Enter, right-click or click the first corner to finish.

data.name: HintDrawPierStart
data.value: Click the shore end of the pier.

data.name: HintDrawPierEnd
data.value: Click the far end of the pier. It squares up with the quay and the piers already there; hold Alt to draw it free, Shift for 15° steps. Esc cancels.

data.name: HintAddBerthsStart
data.value: Click beside a pier where the first berth goes.

data.name: HintAddBerthsEnd
data.value: Click where the row of berths ends (same spot: one berth). Esc cancels.

data.name: HintAddLandBerthsStart
data.value: Click a land area where the boat should stand.

data.name: HintAddLandBerthsHeading
data.value: Click where the bow should point (Shift: 15° steps; same spot: the set heading). Esc cancels.

data.name: HintErase
data.value: Click a berth, pier or land area to remove it. Alt+click a berth to clear that whole pier.

data.name: HintRename
data.value: Click a berth or a pier to give it another name.

data.name: HintSelectArea
data.value: Drag a box over the water to select the berths inside it; hold Shift or Ctrl to add to the ones already selected.

data.name: HintEditServices
data.value: Click a berth to give it the pedestals chosen above; Alt or Ctrl changes that whole side of the pier.

data.name: HintPlaceDividers
data.value: Click beside a row of berths to put a divider on the nearest boundary, or take away the one there; Alt fills the whole row. Ctrl+click or a right-click only removes.

data.name: HintPlantTrees
data.value: Click a lawn to scatter trees on it (replacing the ones it has); Ctrl+click or right-click removes them.

data.name: HintPlantTreesNone
data.value: Tree coverage is 0: click a lawn to remove its trees.

data.name: HintMoveReferenceImage
data.value: Drag with the left mouse button to move the image.

data.name: HintMeasureScaleFirst
data.value: Click one end of the image's scale bar.

data.name: HintMeasureScaleSecond
data.value: Click the other end of the scale bar.

data.name: HintDrawShorelineFirst
data.value: Click to place the first point of the coast (two points are enough for a straight one).

data.name: HintDrawShorelineMore
data.value: Click to add points along the coast, then press Enter. Backspace removes the last one, Esc cancels.

data.name: HintDrawShorelineSide
data.value: Click the side of the line that is land.

data.name: HintDrawShorelineCrossing
data.value: The two ends of this line run into each other, so neither side of it is the land. Move a point or press Esc.

data.name: HintNavigate
data.value: Drag to pan, right-drag to orbit, wheel to zoom.
